summary_1line: On the tenth day’s fierce battles, many duels erupt as the Pandavas push forward with Sikhandin and Arjuna to bring about Bhishma’s fall.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna drives forward with Sikhandin before him toward Bhishma while waves of Kaurava warriors rush in shouting to stop them.
Bhima smashes through the elephant division as gigantic elephants collapse like mountains around his chariot.
Dhrishtaketu and Paurava, their chariots destroyed, circle each other on foot with shining swords and star-studded shields like two lions in combat.
